items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 28:1
items.html: Because the entire returning of the face of Ima to the face of Aba was only in order to impart illumination of Hochma to ZON, by virtue of the connection she has to impart illumination of Hochma to the ZON of direct light, therefore even after her coupling face-to-face with Aba, she receives from him only according to the measure by which the Bina of direct light imparts illumination of Hochma to the ZON of direct light. And it is known that the ZON of direct light is essentially the light of Hassadim, apart from the illumination of Hochma that the Bina imparts to it. Therefore here too she imparts to it mainly only Hassadim and Gevurot, together with only an illumination of Hochma. And therefore even in Aba and Ima who are at the level of Keter, Ima does not receive from Aba the light of Hochma that is in the Keter, but only the illumination of Hochma that is in the ZON of the Keter. And this is the level of the degree, from below upward, in Aba and Ima, called the Daat of Aba and Ima, which is considered to be the Rosh of Melech HaDaat [the King of Daat]. (Item 41, and Item 9 in Inner Observation)
